# TaskLabelAsTaskTitle

use `taskDescription.label` as task title in recent task list

like for `Chrome Custom Tabs` and `Alipay Mini Program`, the task title is the page title, not the app name

| before | after |
|-----------------------------|---------------------------|

readmeZh:
# 任务标签作为任务标题

使用“taskDescription.label”作为最近任务列表中的任务标题

与“Chrome自定义标签”和“支付宝小程序”一样，任务标题是页面标题，而不是应用名称

|之前|之后|
|----------------------------|----------------------------|
| ![之前](https://github.com/duzhaokun123/TaskLabelAsTaskTitle/raw/main/arts/before1.png) | ![之后](https://github.com/duzhaokun123/TaskLabelAsTaskTitle/raw/main/arts/after1.png) |
| ![之前](https://github.com/duzhaokun123/TaskLabelAsTaskTitle/raw/main/arts/before2.png) | ![之后](https://github.com/duzhaokun123/TaskLabelAsTaskTitle/raw/main/arts/after2.png) |
